course.title: Unit 3 My weekend plan-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（Where and when are you going?）

sentences.content: What is Amy going to do?
sentences.english: What is Amy going to do ?

sentences.content: Is the ice cream for John?
sentences.english: Is the ice cream for John ?

sentences.content: My cousin Jack is going to visit me next week.
sentences.english: My cousin Jack is going to visit me next week
sentences.chinese: 我的表弟Jack下周要来看我。

sentences.content: We’re going to see a film about space travel!
sentences.english: We're going to see a film about space travel !
sentences.chinese: 我们要去看一部关于太空旅行的电影！

sentences.content: Cool! I have lots of comic books about space.
sentences.english: Cool ! I have lots of comic books about space
sentences.chinese: 太棒了！我有好多关于太空的漫画书。
为什么不在星期二去呢？

sentences.content: Where are you going this afternoon?
sentences.english: Where are you going this afternoon ?

sentences.content: What are you going to do there?
sentences.english: What are you going to do there ?

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: I’m going to buy a new comic book.
sentences.english: I'm going to buy a new comic book
sentences.chinese: 我要去买一本新的漫画书。

sentences.content: Yes. Do you have comic books?
sentences.english: Yes . Do you have comic books ?

sentences.content: What are you going to buy, Sarah?
sentences.english: What are you going to buy , Sarah ?

sentences.content: I’m going to buy some word books.
sentences.english: I'm going to buy some word books
sentences.chinese: 我打算去买几本单词书。

sentences.content: What do your family do on these days?
sentences.english: What do your family do on these days ?
sentences.chinese: 你们家这些天都在做什么？

sentences.content: My family are going to get together and have a big dinner.
sentences.english: My family are going to get together and have a big dinner
sentences.chinese: 我们全家要聚在一起吃顿丰盛的晚餐。

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: My aunt is going to make mooncakes.
sentences.english: My aunt is going to make mooncakes

sentences.content: My grandma will tell us a story about Chang’e.
sentences.english: My grandma will tell us a story about Chang'e
sentences.chinese: 我的奶奶会给我们讲一个关于嫦娥的故事。

sentences.content: Robin and I are going to read a poem.
sentences.english: Robin and I are going to read a poem

wordDetails.definition: be（现在时复数）: 构成进行时

sentences.content: We will all be together tonight.
sentences.english: We will all be together tonight

sentences.content: We eat mooncakes and tell stories about the moon.
sentences.english: We eat mooncakes and tell stories about the moon
sentences.chinese: 我们吃月饼，讲关于月亮的故事。

sentences.content: L is for love. We love Mid-Autumn Festival.
sentences.english: L is for love . We love Mid-Autumn Festival
sentences.chinese: L 代表爱。我们热爱中秋节。
